source: Homework 4/5 failure taxonomy; prevalence from the policy_id_in_reply code check over all 251 conversations in traces/support_traces.json (prompt 64ee12c975a5), which agrees with all 128 human-reviewed labels
why_agent_can_change_it: In all three replies the agent writes the internal id (cw-returns) next to the policy it cites, because SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE tells it to 'Cite the policy id (for example cw-returns) for every policy claim', and the policy tools return the id with each match. Changing the prompt instruction, what the tool returns, or a reply check in the harness can each stop the id from reaching the user.
